summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K announcing approval of a $0.64 per share shareholder distribution, combining a $0.20 interim dividend and a $0.44 payment from share premium reserve, to be paid from June 10, 2026. No further terms such as premium or price are applicable since this is a routine capital return. The board approved the distribution, with no advisors named. Ex-dividend dates vary by exchange (NYSE T+1, Euronext T+2). The remaining share premium balance remains available for future distributions. This is a straightforward cash return with no special situation triggers beyond a standard payout.
